# Kaico Voice
> Website, Google Business Profile, phone and job-system services for trade businesses. English and Spanish site guides below.

## English: overview
- [Website, Google Listing and Phone for Trades | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/): Website, Google listing, phone and job-system services for trade businesses.
- [Pricing | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/pricing): Published one-time and monthly options, with terms and scope details.
- [Proof | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/proof): Examples of completed work and how Kaico checks reported numbers.
- [Start Your Project | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/start): Request a review of your website, listing, phone or job workflow.

## English: services
- [Contractor Marketing Services, Done For You | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/front-door): Monthly website, listing, phone, scheduling and job-system service.
- [After-Hours Answering Service for the Trades | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/phone): Phone answering and calendar booking for trade businesses.
- [Contractor Website Design | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/websites): Website builds with contact and quote-request paths.
- [Job System for Trade Shops | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/job-system): Jobs, quotes, invoices and customer email workflow.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/google-business-profile): Google Business Profile setup and ongoing care.
- [Google Ads Management for Contractors | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/google-ads): Managed search and call advertising; ad spend is separate.
- [Business Consulting in Tulsa | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/services/business-consulting): Process review, workflow map and prioritized plan.

## English: policies
- [Client Services Agreement | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/client-agreement): Payment, ownership, cancellation and service terms.
- [Privacy Policy | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/privacy): How information is handled, including calls to the AI receptionist.
- [Terms of Service | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/terms): Website, service and SMS terms.
- [SMS Program Details | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/sms): SMS consent, message types and opt-out details.

## Español: información general

- [Precios | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/pricing): Opciones publicadas de pago único y mensual, con detalles de condiciones y alcance.
- [Nuestro trabajo | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/proof): Ejemplos de trabajo realizado y cómo Kaico verifica las cifras publicadas.
- [Inicia tu proyecto | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/start): Solicita una revisión de tu sitio, perfil, teléfono o proceso de trabajos.

## Español: servicios
- [Servicios de marketing para contratistas | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/front-door): Servicio mensual de sitio web, perfil, teléfono, reservas y sistema de trabajos.
- [Teléfono fuera de horario para oficios | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/phone): Atención telefónica y reservas en calendario para negocios de oficios.
- [Diseño de sitios web para contratistas | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/websites): Creación de sitios web con opciones de contacto y solicitud de cotización.
- [Sistema de trabajos para negocios de oficios | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/job-system): Gestión de trabajos, cotizaciones, facturas y correos a clientes.
- [Optimización del Perfil de Negocio de Google | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/google-business-profile): Configuración y mantenimiento del Perfil de Negocio de Google.
- [Administración de Google Ads para contratistas | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/google-ads): Gestión de anuncios de búsqueda y llamadas; inversión publicitaria aparte.
- [Consultoría de negocios en Tulsa | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/services/business-consulting): Revisión de procesos, mapa de trabajo y plan priorizado.

## Español: políticas
- [Acuerdo de servicios al cliente | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/client-agreement): Condiciones de pago, propiedad, cancelación y servicio.
- [Política de privacidad | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/privacy): Tratamiento de datos, incluidas las llamadas a la recepcionista con IA.
- [Términos de servicio | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/terms): Condiciones del sitio web, los servicios y los SMS.
- [Detalles del programa de SMS | Kaico Voice](https://www.kaicovoice.com/es/sms): Consentimiento, tipos de mensajes y baja del programa de SMS.
